glossary.naçió: nacer — he was born (preterite 3rd sg.; = nació)
glossary.sopo: saber — he learned, found out (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = supo)
glossary.creçe: crecer — grows, increases (present 3rd sg.; = crece, ç sounded ts)
glossary.valdrá: valer — he will be worth, will count for (future 3rd sg.; = valdrá)
glossary.sale: salir — he goes out (present 3rd sg.; = sale)
glossary.dont: dont — from where, whence (Latin de unde; = de donde, donde); also temporal, 'when, as soon as' (dont a ojo los ovo 'as soon as he had them in sight')
glossary.lléganle: llegar + le — they come up to him (present 3rd pl. llegan + enclitic le; = le llegan)
glossary.ban: ir — they go (present 3rd pl.; = van, with b for v); ban besar 'they go to kiss'
glossary.ruego: rogar — I pray, beseech (present 1st sg.; = ruego)
glossary.spirital: spirital — spiritual (adjective; Padre spirital 'the spiritual Father', God the Father; Señor spirital 'spiritual Lord'; = espiritual)
glossary.dexades: dexar — you leave, abandon (present 2nd pl.; = dejáis)
glossary.enantes: enantes — before, sooner (adverb; enantes que 'before'; = antes)
glossary.muera: morir — I die (present subjunctive 1st sg.; = muera)
glossary.pueda: poder — I may be able (present subjunctive 1st sg.; = pueda)
glossary.doblado: doblado — doubled, twofold (adjective used as adverb; = doblado)
glossary.cobrar: cobrar — to recover, win back, make good (infinitive, most likely depending on pueda of v. 302: 'that I may win it back for you'; = cobrar)
glossary.plogo: plazer — it pleased (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = plugo, modern plació)
glossary.creçió: crecer — it grew, increased (preterite 3rd sg.; = creció)
glossary.quantos: quanto — as many as (masc. pl.; todos quantos 'all who'; = cuantos)
glossary.están: estar — they are, stay (present 3rd pl.; = están) · also progressive auxiliary with a gerund (bendiziéndol están 'they are blessing him')
glossary.passados: passar — passed, elapsed (past participle masc. pl.; = pasados)
glossary.troçir: troçir — to pass, elapse (infinitive; no modern equivalent, closest transcurrir)
glossary.sepades: saber — you know; sepades que 'be aware that' (present subjunctive 2nd pl., as a command; = sepáis)
glossary.aguardar: aguardar — to watch, keep watch on (infinitive; mandó aguardar 'ordered (him) watched'; = aguardar)
glossary.plazo: plazo — term, time limit (spelling without d; = plazo)
glossary.tierral: tierra + le — land + him (enclitic le reduced to l: en su tierra le 'in his land, him'; = tierra le)
glossary.pudies: poder — he could (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg.; = pudiese)
glossary.podríe: poder — he could (conditional 3rd sg., -íe ending; = podría)
glossary.querié: querer — it was about to (imperfect 3rd sg., -ié ending; la noch querié entrar 'night was about to fall'; = quería) · also querer — he wished (imperfect 3rd sg.; commo querié trasnochar 'how he wished to travel by night'; = quería)
glossary.entrar: entrar — to enter, set in (infinitive; = entrar)
glossary.mandólos: mandar + los — he ordered them (preterite 3rd sg. mandó + enclitic los; = los mandó)
glossary.caya: caer — let it fall (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; non vos caya en pesar 'let it not fall as grief on you'; = caiga)
glossary.membrados: membrado — mindful, remembering (adjective, from membrar 'to remember'; seed membrados 'be mindful'; no modern equivalent, closest acordados)
glossary.devedes: dever — you ought, must (present 2nd pl.; = debéis)
glossary.mañana: mañana — morning (a la mañana 'in the morning'; otro dia mañana 'next morning'; = mañana)
glossary.cantarán: cantar — they will crow, sing (future 3rd pl.; = cantarán)
glossary.tardedes: tardar — you delay (present subjunctive 2nd pl., in a negative command; = tardéis)
glossary.mandedes: mandar — you order (present subjunctive 2nd pl., command; = mandéis)
glossary.tandrá: tañer — he will ring (future 3rd sg., syncopated stem tandr- with a d between n and r; = tañerá)
glossary.dirá: dezir — he will say (future 3rd sg.; = dirá)
glossary.trinidad: Trinidad — the Holy Trinity (de santa Trinidad 'of the Holy Trinity', the mass chosen; = Trinidad)
glossary.dicha: dezir — said (past participle fem.; la missa dicha 'mass having been said'; = dicha)
glossary.penssemos: pensar — let us set about (present subjunctive 1st pl., exhortation; pensar de + inf.; = pensemos)
glossary.andar: andar — to travel, go on (infinitive; = andar)
glossary.quomo: commo — as (variant spelling, Pidal's Qu[o]mo; = como)
glossary.passando: passar — passing (gerund; Passando va la noch 'the night keeps passing'; = pasando)
glossary.man: man — morning (the short form, from Latin mane; = mañana)
glossary.mediados: mediado — middle, half-way through (past participle used as adjective; los mediados gallos 'the mid-cockcrow'; = mediados)
glossary.priessa: priessa — haste, bustle (a una priessa 'all in one bustle'; = prisa) · also a priessa — 'quickly, in haste' (adverbial; a priessa espoloneavan 'they spurred in haste')
glossary.vane: ir — they go (present 3rd pl. with epic paragogic -e; = van)
glossary.echós: echar + se — she threw herself down (preterite 3rd sg. echó + enclitic -s(e); = se echó)
glossary.grados: grado — step (pl.; the altar steps; = grados, gradas)
glossary.delantel: delante + el — before the (delante el, run together; = delante del)
glossary.mejor: mejor — better, best (adverb; quanto ella mejor sabe 'as best she knows how'; = mejor)
glossary.curiás: curiar — (that God) might guard (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg., curiasse with its -e lost, like pudies; = guardase; no modern curiar)
glossary.male: mal — harm, evil (with epic paragogic -e; = mal)
glossary.estase: estar — you are, dwell (present 2nd sg. estás with epic paragogic -e; = estás)
glossary.fezist: fazer — you made (preterite 2nd sg.; = hiciste, note f-)
glossary.terçero: terçero — third (ordinal; el terçero 'the third (element)'; = tercero)
glossary.escalentare: escalentar — to warm (infinitive with epic paragogic -e; = calentar)
glossary.prisist: prender — you took on (strong preterite 2nd sg.; prisist encarnaçión 'you took flesh'; = prendiste, closest tomaste)
glossary.encarnaçión: encarnaçión — incarnation, the taking of flesh (= encarnación)
glossary.veluntade: voluntad — will (variant veluntad with epic paragogic -e; de veluntade 'willingly'; = voluntad)
glossary.te: te — you, thee (2nd sg. object pronoun)
glossary.ouieron: aver — they had (strong preterite 3rd pl., spelled ou- for ov-; ouieron a laudare 'they set about praising'; = hubieron)
glossary.laudare: laudar — to praise (infinitive in its Latin shape, the final -e printed, not restored; learned word; = loar)
glossary.arabia: Arabia — Arabia, the eastern land from which the Magi came
glossary.adorare: adorar — to worship (infinitive with epic paragogic -e; = adorar)
glossary.melchior: Melchior — Melchior, one of the three Magi
glossary.caspar: Caspar — Gaspar, one of the three Magi (Pidal restores [C]aspar)
glossary.baltasare: Baltasar — Balthasar, one of the three Magi (with epic paragogic -e)
glossary.jonás: Jonás — Jonah, the prophet cast into the sea and swallowed by the great fish
glossary.daniel: Daniel — Daniel, the prophet saved from the lions' den
glossary.mala: malo — bad, evil (fem.; la mala cárçel 'the evil prison'; = mala)
glossary.sebastián: Sebastián — St Sebastian, the Roman soldier-martyr, saved in legend after being shot with arrows
glossary.susanna: Susanna — Susanna, the chaste wife falsely accused by the elders (Daniel 13), saved by Daniel
glossary.criminal: criminal — accusation, charge (noun; del falso criminal 'from the false charge'; modern criminal is only adjective/noun 'criminal'; closest crimen)
glossary.andidiste: andar — you walked (preterite 2nd sg. on the analogical stem andid-; = anduviste)
glossary.resuçitest: resuçitar — you raised from the dead (preterite 2nd sg., transitive; = resucitaste)
glossary.lázaro: Lázaro — Lazarus, whom Christ raised from the dead
glossary.dexeste: dexar — you let, allowed (preterite 2nd sg.; te dexeste prender 'you let yourself be seized'; = dejaste)
glossary.dizen: dezir — they say, they call (present 3rd pl.; do dizen monte Calvarie 'where they call (it) Mount Calvary'; = dicen)
glossary.calvarie: Calvarie — Calvary, the hill of the crucifixion (Latin Calvariae; = Calvario)
glossary.pusiéronte: poner + te — they put you (strong preterite 3rd pl. pusieron + enclitic te; = te pusieron)
glossary.nombre: nombre — name; por nombre 'by name, called' (= nombre)
glossary.golgotá: Golgotá — Golgotha, the place of the Crucifixion (= Gólgota)
glossary.contigo: contigo — with you (con + ti + -go, 2nd sg.; = contigo)
glossary.paradiso: paradiso — paradise (learned form; Pidal's para[d]iso; = paraíso)
glossary.otro: otro — other, another (masc.; el otro 'the other'; = otro) · also otro día 'the next day'; lo otro 'the rest'
glossary.estando: estar — being, standing (gerund; estando en la cruz 'while on the cross'; = estando)
glossary.longinos: Longinos — Longinus, in legend the blind soldier who pierced Christ's side and was healed when the blood touched his eyes
glossary.vido: veer — he saw (strong preterite 3rd sg.; Pidal's vi[d]o; = vio)
glossary.alguandre: alguandre — ever, at any time (adverb; nunqua ... alguandre 'never ... ever'; no modern equivalent, closest alguna vez)
glossary.diot: dar + te — he struck you, gave you (preterite 3rd sg. dio + enclitic t(e); diot con la lança 'he struck you with the lance'; = te dio)
glossary.yxió: exir — it came out (preterite 3rd sg.; = salió, exir being the old salir)
glossary.astil: astil — shaft of a lance (= astil, asta)
glossary.ayuso: ayuso — down, downward (adverb, Latin deorsum; no modern equivalent, closest abajo)
glossary.alçólas: alçar + las — he raised them (preterite 3rd sg. alçó + enclitic las; = las alzó)
glossary.arriba: arriba — up, upward (adverb; = arriba) · also postposed 'up, upstream' (Fenares arriba 'up the Henares'; desí arriba 'from there upward')
glossary.cató: catar — he looked (preterite 3rd sg.; cató a todas partes 'he looked all around'; = miró; modern catar means 'to taste, examine')
glossary.ti: ti — you (2nd sg., stressed pronoun after a preposition; = ti)
glossary.crovo: creer — he believed (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = creyó)
glossary.end: end — of it, thence (adverbial pronoun, apocopated ende; por end 'for that reason'; no modern equivalent, closest de ello)
glossary.monumento: monumento — tomb, sepulchre (learned sense of Latin monumentum; = sepulcro)
glossary.oviste: aver — you had (strong preterite 2nd sg.; oviste a resuçitar, aver a + inf., little more than 'you rose'; = hubiste)
glossary.resuçitar: resuçitar — to rise from the dead (infinitive, intransitive; = resucitar)
glossary.fust: ir — you went (preterite 2nd sg., shared with seer; fust a los infiernos 'you went down to hell'; = fuiste)
glossary.crebanteste: crebantar — you shattered, broke (preterite 2nd sg.; Pidal restores [cr]ebanteste; = quebrantaste)
glossary.saqueste: sacar — you drew out, led out (preterite 2nd sg.; = sacaste)
glossary.padres: padre — fathers (pl.; los santos padres, the patriarchs freed from hell; = padres)
glossary.todel: todo + el — all the (todo + el run together; de todel mundo 'of the whole world'; = todo el)
glossary.adoro: adorar — I adore, worship (present 1st sg.; = adoro)
glossary.credo: creer — I believe (present 1st sg., Latin credo; Pidal's cre[d]o; = creo)
glossary.peydro: Peydro — Peter, St Peter (variant of Pero; = Pedro)
glossary.rogar: rogar — to pray (infinitive; ayude a rogar 'help (me) to pray'; = rogar)
glossary.curie: curiar — may (God) guard (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; no modern curiar, = guarde)
glossary.partimos: partir — we part, separate (present 1st pl.; = partimos)
glossary.salieron: salir — they went out (preterite 3rd pl.; = salieron)
glossary.ívala: ir + la — he went to … her/it (imperfect 3rd sg. iva + enclitic la; ívala abraçar 'he went to embrace her'; ívala traspassar 'he went to cross it', la = the calçada; = la iba a …)
glossary.tornólas: tornar + las — he turned back to them (preterite 3rd sg. tornó + enclitic las; tornólas a catar 'he turned to look at them'; = las tornó a mirar)
glossary.catar: catar — to look at (infinitive; = mirar; modern catar means 'to taste, examine')
glossary.ajuntar: ajuntar — to join, reunite (infinitive used as noun, el ajuntar 'the reuniting'; = juntar, reunir)
glossary.vidiestes: veer — you saw (preterite 2nd pl.; Pidal's vi[d]iestes; = visteis)
glossary.atal: atal — such, such a thing (adjective/pronoun; no modern equivalent, = tal)
glossary.assis: assí + se — thus ... themselves (assí + reflexive se reduced to -s; assis parten 'thus they part'; = así se)
glossary.parten: partir — they part, separate (present 3rd pl.; = parten)
glossary.penssó: pensar — he set about (preterite 3rd sg.; pensar de + inf. 'to set about doing'; = pensó)
glossary.tornando: tornar — turning (gerund; la cabeça tornando va 'he goes turning his head'; = tornando)
glossary.minaya: Minaya — the title by which the Cid's kinsman Álvar Fáñez is called, usually explained as mi + anaya 'my brother'
glossary.albar: Albar — Álvar (Albar Fáñez, the Cid's lieutenant and kinsman; = Álvar)
glossary.nasquiestes: nacer — you were born (preterite 2nd pl. on the strong stem nasqu-; en buen[a] nasquiestes 'you were born in a good hour'; = nacisteis)
glossary.pensemos: pensar — let us set about (present subjunctive 1st pl., exhortation; pensar de + inf.; = pensemos)
glossary.vía: vía — road, journey (nuestra vía 'our way'; = vía)
glossary.vagar: vagar — leisure, slowness (noun; de vagar 'at leisure, unhurriedly'; = vagar, closest despacio)
glossary.tornarán: tornar — they will turn (future 3rd pl.; se tornarán en gozo 'will turn into joy'; = tornarán)
glossary.tornan: tornar — they turn, go back (present 3rd pl.; tornan de castigar 'they go back to instructing'; = tornan)
glossary.sirva: servir — he is to serve (present subjunctive 3rd sg., indirect command; = sirva)
glossary.ellas: ella — they, them (fem. pl., stressed; con ellas 'with them'; = ellas)
glossary.sepa: saber — let him know (present subjunctive 3rd sg., as a command; = sepa)
glossary.dello: de + ello — of it, for it (de + neuter ello; = de ello)
glossary.prendrá: prender — he will receive, take (future 3rd sg. with syncopated stem; = prenderá)
glossary.tornado: tornar — returned (past participle; tornado es 'has returned', ser as perfect auxiliary; = tornado)
glossary.viéredes: veer — (if) you see, should see (future subjunctive 2nd pl.; si viéredes 'if you see'; = viereis, now only in legal usage; ordinary si veis)
glossary.connusco: connusco — with us (con + nos + -co; = con nosotros)
glossary.dezildes: dezir + les — tell them (imperative 2nd pl. dezid + enclitic les, with d-l metathesis dezildes for dezidles; = decidles)
glossary.prendan: prender — let them take (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; prendan el rastro 'let them take the trail'; = prendan)
glossary.pienssen: pensar — let them set about (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; pensar de + inf.; = piensen)
glossary.poblado: poblado — inhabited place, settlement (noun from poblar; = poblado) · also poblar — settled, encamped (past part.; avie poblado 'had settled, camped')
glossary.poder: poder — to be able (infinitive; first half of a split future, poder nos han alcançar 'they will be able to overtake us'; = poder) · also poder — power, hands, control (noun; en so poder 'in his keeping'; = poder)
glossary.soltaron: soltar — they let go, slackened (preterite 3rd pl.; = soltaron)
glossary.quitar: quitar — to leave, quit (infinitive; el reyno quitar 'to quit the kingdom'; = quitar, closest abandonar) · also 'to set free' (quiero las i quitar 'I mean to free them there'; Pidal: 'libertar')
glossary.yazer: yazer — to lie, lodge (infinitive; vino yazer 'came to lie for the night'; = yacer)
glossary.spinaz: Spinaz — Espinaz(o), first word of Spinaz de Can, a place on the Cid's road out of Castile; spinaz = 'backbone'
glossary.can: Can — 'dog' (Latin canis), second part of the place name Spinaz de Can, 'Dog's Backbone'
glossary.sele: se + le — themselves ... to him (reflexive se + dative le written as one; sele acojen 'gather to him'; = se le)
glossary.acojen: acoger — they gather, rally (reflexive se acogen; present 3rd pl. spelled with j; = acogen)
glossary.pienssa: pensar — he sets about (present 3rd sg.; pensar de + inf.; = piensa)
glossary.ixiendos: exir + se — going out (gerund ixiendo + enclitic -s(e); ixiendos va 'is going out'; = saliéndose)
glossary.siniestro: siniestro — left side, left hand (noun; de siniestro 'on the left'; = siniestro, closest izquierda)
glossary.estevan: Estevan — Esteban, i.e. San Esteban de Gormaz, a town on the Duero
glossary.alcobiella: Alcobiella — Alcubilla, a village on the border of Castile, on the Cid's road
glossary.fin: fin — end, boundary (fem. in Old Spanish; de Castiella fin 'the boundary of Castile'; = fin)
glossary.quinea: Quinea — Quinea, a stretch of the old paved road on the Cid's route
glossary.navas: Navas — Navas (de Palos), a place by the Duero on the Cid's route; nava = 'flat hollow between hills'
glossary.palos: Palos — second element of Navas de Palos, a place on the Duero
glossary.passar: passar — to cross, pass over (infinitive; = pasar)
glossary.figueruela: Figueruela — La Figueruela, a place on the Cid's route (= Higueruela)
glossary.iva: ir — he was going (imperfect 3rd sg.; iva posar 'was going to halt'; = iba)
glossary.posar: posar — to lodge, halt for the night (infinitive; = posar)
glossary.vánssele: ir + se + le — (they) keep going ... to him (present 3rd pl. van + reflexive se + dative le; vánssele acogiendo 'they keep gathering to him'; = se le van)
glossary.echava: echar — he was lying down, throwing himself (imperfect 3rd sg., -ava; echarse 'to lie down'; i se echava 'he lay down there'; = echaba)
glossary.sueñol: sueño + le — sleep + 'him' (noun with the enclitic object pronoun le, e elided; un sueñol priso dulçe 'a sweet sleep took him'; modern Spanish has no enclitic on nouns, = le tomó un sueño)
glossary.adurmió: adormir(se) — he fell asleep (preterite 3rd sg., reflexive se adurmió; = se durmió, closest se adormeció)
glossary.visión: visión — vision, dream-vision (= visión; en visión 'in a vision')
glossary.cavalgad: cavalgar — ride! (2nd pl. imperative, polite plural to a single person; = cabalgad)
glossary.punto: punto — moment, point of time, hour (en tan buen punto 'at so good a moment'; = punto, closest hora/ocasión)
glossary.varón: varón — man, male, man of worth (= varón)
glossary.visquiéredes: bivir — you shall live (future subjunctive 2nd pl., strong stem visqu- from Latin vixerit; mientra que visquiéredes 'as long as you live'; = viviereis, a tense now obsolete)
glossary.fará: fazer — it/he will do, make (future 3rd sg., syncopated; se fará 'will be done'; = hará)
glossary.to: to — thy, your (possessive 2nd sg.; here pronominal, lo to 'what is yours'; = lo tuyo; unstressed before a noun, = tu)
glossary.despertó: despertar — he woke up (preterite 3rd sg.; = despertó)
glossary.santigó: santiguar — he crossed (himself) (preterite 3rd sg., older santigar; la cara se santigó 'he made the sign of the cross on his face'; = santiguó, se santiguó)
glossary.sinava: sinar — he was signing, making the cross on (imperfect 3rd sg.; Latin signare; sinar la cara 'to cross one's face'; = signaba, closest persignaba)
glossary.acomendar: acomendar — to commend (infinitive; a Dios se fo acomendar 'he went to commend himself to God'; = encomendar)
glossary.sueño: sueño — dream; also sleep (= sueño; del sueño que soñado a 'of the dream he has dreamed')
glossary.miedes: Miedes — Miedes (de Atienza), a place in the north of Guadalajara province; sierra de Miedes, the range near it on the Cid's route (traditional identification)
glossary.ivan: ir — they were going (imperfect 3rd pl.; ivan posar 'they were going to lodge'; = iban)
glossary.diestro: diestro — right (hand, side), noun use (de diestro 'on the right'; = diestro, closest derecha)
glossary.atiença: Atiença — Atienza, fortified town in Guadalajara province (= Atienza; traditional identification)
glossary.puesto: poner — set (past part.; non era puesto el sol 'the sun had not set'; = puesto)
glossary.peonadas: peonada — company of foot-soldiers (collective from peón; = peonada, which in modern Spanish means a group of laborers or a day's labor)
glossary.notó: notar — he noted, counted (preterite 3rd sg.; = notó, closest contó)
glossary.trezientas: trezientos — three hundred (fem. pl., agreeing with lanças; = trescientas)
glossary.lanças: lança — lance; also the horseman who bears it (pl.; = lanzas)
glossary.tienen: tener — they have, hold, carry (present 3rd pl.; todas tienen pendones 'all carry pennons'; = tienen)
glossary.sí: sí — so, thus (optative particle, Latin sic; sí el Criador vos salue 'so may the Creator save you'; = así, no modern use as a particle)
glossary.salue: salvar — may he save (present subjunctive 3rd sg., optative; = salve)
glossary.cavalgue: cavalgar — let him ride (present subjunctive 3rd sg., jussive; = cabalgue)
glossary.passaremos: passar — we shall cross, pass (future 1st pl.; = pasaremos)
glossary.fiera: fiero — fierce, rugged, wild (fem.; la sierra que fiera es 'the range, which is rugged'; = fiera, fem. of fiero)
glossary.alfonso: Alfonso — King Alfonso (VI of León and Castile), the Cid's lord (= Alfonso)
glossary.podemos: poder — we can, are able (present 1st pl.; = podemos)
glossary.buscare: buscar — shall seek (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; qui nos buscare 'whoever shall seek us'; = buscare, tense obsolete)
glossary.podrá: poder — he will be able (future 3rd sg.; = podrá)
glossary.passan: passar — they cross, pass (present 3rd pl.; = pasan)
glossary.vinida: venir — come, arrived (fem. past part. vinida; vinida es la man 'morning has come', ser as auxiliary of an intransitive; = venida)
glossary.loma: loma — ridge, long low hill, hillside (= loma)
glossary.fizo: fazer — he made, did, caused (strong preterite 3rd sg.; fizo posar 'he made (them) halt'; = hizo)
glossary.díxoles: dezir + les — he said to them (preterite dixo + enclitic dative les; = les dijo)
glossary.trasnochar: trasnochar — to travel through the night, go without sleep (infinitive; = trasnochar 'to stay up all night')
glossary.anochesca: anochecer — night falls (present subjunctive 3rd sg., -sc- stem; ante que anochesca 'before night falls'; = anochezca)
glossary.tal: tal — such; por tal 'for such a reason, for this purpose' (= tal)
glossary.ventasse: ventar — should scent, detect (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg., -asse; que no lo ventasse nadi 'that no one should get wind of it'; = ventease, closest ventear, 'to sniff out')
glossary.andidieron: andar — they travelled, marched (strong preterite 3rd pl.; = anduvieron)
glossary.dan: dar — they give (present 3rd pl.; vagar non se dan 'they allow themselves no leisure'; = dan) · also dar — 'to pay (tribute)' (dan parias 'they pay tribute')
glossary.castejón: Castejón — Castejón, a town taken by the Cid, traditionally Castejón de Henares (Guadalajara province); not the modern Navarrese Castejón
glossary.fenares: Fenares — the river Henares (f- for h-; = Henares)
glossary.echó: echar — he threw, cast (preterite 3rd sg.; echarse en çelada 'to lie in ambush'; = echó)
glossary.çelada: çelada — ambush (en çelada 'in ambush'; sacar a çelada 'to draw out into an ambush'; = celada, 'ambush, trap')
glossary.aquellos: aquel — those (masc. pl. demonstrative; con aquellos que 'with those who'; = aquellos)
glossary.consejava: consejar — he advised (imperfect 3rd sg.; commo los consejava 'as he advised them'; = aconsejaba)
glossary.álbar: Álbar — Álvar (personal name, Álbar Fáñez; = Álvar)
glossary.aquesta: aquesta — this (fem. sg., reinforced demonstrative; = esta, archaic aquesta)
glossary.sacaremos: sacar — we shall draw out (future 1st pl.; sacar a çelada 'to lure out into ambush'; = sacaremos)
glossary.teniendo: tener — holding (gerund; teniendo a la çaga 'holding the rearguard'; = teniendo)
glossary.çaga: çaga — rear, rearguard (a la çaga 'at the rear'; = zaga)
glossary.algara: algara — raid, foray, raiding party (Arabic al-ghāra; ir en algara 'to go on a raid'; = algara, now a historical word)
glossary.auze: auze — luck, fortune (vuestra auze 'your good fortune'; a word of augury, usually traced to Latin avis 'bird'; rare, and its exact sense not certain; closest suerte, ventura)
glossary.feremos: fazer — we shall make, win (future 1st pl., syncopated; feremos ganançia 'we shall make gain'; = haremos)
glossary.id: ir — go! (2nd pl. imperative; id vos 'go (you)', with reflexive vos; = id, idos)
glossary.vaya: ir — let him go (present subjunctive 3rd sg., jussive; = vaya)
glossary.salvadórez: Salvadórez — patronymic 'son of Salvador' (modern cognate Salvadores)
glossary.falla: falla — failure, lack (noun; sin falla 'without fail'; = falla, closest falta)
glossary.garciaz: Garciaz — patronymic 'son of García' (modern cognate Garcés)
glossary.fardida: fardido — bold, valiant (fem.; fardida lança 'bold lance', i.e. a bold warrior; a by-form of ardido with initial f-; no modern equivalent, closest ardido, audaz)
glossary.acompañen: acompañar — may they accompany (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; = acompañen)
glossary.aosadas: aosadas — boldly, resolutely (adverb from a osadas; = a osadas, archaic; closest osadamente)
glossary.corred: correr — run!, ride!, raid! (2nd pl. imperative; correr 'to overrun, raid'; = corred)
glossary.dexedes: dexar — you leave, may you leave (present subjunctive 2nd pl.; que … non dexedes nada 'so that you leave nothing'; = dejéis)
glossary.fita: Fita — Hita, town in Guadalajara province (f- for h-; = Hita; traditional identification) · also fito — fixed, pitched (past part. fem., Latin fictus; una tienda fita 'one tent left pitched'; = hincada)
glossary.guadalfajara: Guadalfajara — Guadalajara, city on the Henares (Arabic wādī al-ḥijāra 'river of stones'; = Guadalajara)
glossary.fata: fata — until, as far as (variant of fasta; = hasta)
glossary.alcalá: Alcalá — Alcalá de Henares (traditional identification; Arabic al-qalʿa 'the castle'; = Alcalá de Henares)
glossary.lleguen: llegar — may they arrive, reach (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; = lleguen)
glossary.acojan: acoger — may they gather in, collect (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; acojan ganançias 'let them collect the spoils'; = acojan, but modern acoger means 'to welcome, shelter')
glossary.dexen: dexar — may they leave (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; = dejen)
glossary.fincaré: fincar — I shall remain (future 1st sg.; = quedaré, closest; modern hincar means 'to drive in')
glossary.terné: tener — I shall hold, keep (future 1st sg., tenré with its n and r swapped; = tendré)
glossary.abremos: aver — we shall have (future 1st pl., syncopated; = habremos)
glossary.enpara: enpara — protection, defence, refuge (noun, from amparar; = amparo)
glossary.cueta: cueta — distress, trouble, urgent need (= cuita, 'grief, trouble'; closest apuro)
glossary.fazedme: fazer + me — do for me (2nd pl. imperative fazed + enclitic me; fazedme mandado 'send me word'; = hacedme)
glossary.acorro: acorro — help, succour (noun, from acorrer 'to run to help'; no modern noun, closest socorro)
glossary.nombrados: nombrar — named, appointed (past part. masc. pl.; = nombrados)
glossary.irán: ir — they will go (future 3rd pl.; = irán)
glossary.fincarán: fincar — they will remain (future 3rd pl.; = quedarán, closest)
glossary.crieban: crebar — they break (present indicative 3rd pl., stem creb- with the stressed e diphthongized to ie, + -an; ya crieban los albores 'now the dawn breaks'; the cr is Pidal's restoration; = quiebran, modern quebrar)
glossary.vinie: venir — it came (imperfect 3rd sg., -ié ending; vinie la mañana 'morning came'; = venía)
glossary.ixie: exir — it was rising, going out (imperfect 3rd sg., -ié; ixie el sol 'the sun was rising'; = salía; no modern exir)
glossary.apuntava: apuntar — it was appearing, dawning (imperfect 3rd sg.; qué fermoso apuntava 'how fair it broke'; = apuntaba)
glossary.levantavan: levantar(se) — they were rising, getting up (imperfect 3rd pl.; = levantaban)
glossary.fuera: fuera — outside, out of doors (adverb; de fuera 'outside, from outside'; = fuera)
glossary.davan: dar — they were giving (imperfect 3rd pl.; salto davan 'they made a dash'; = daban) · also dar — 'to deal blows' (sin piedad les davan 'they struck them without mercy')
glossary.ver: ver — to see (infinitive; por ver 'in order to see, to look to'; = ver)
glossary.lavores: lavor — work, labor; here worked fields (pl.; = labores)
glossary.heredanças: heredança — inherited estate, landholding (pl.; = herencias, heredades; closest heredades)
glossary.exidos: exir — gone out (past part. masc. pl.; son exidos 'have gone out', ser as auxiliary; = salidos)
glossary.dexadas: dexar — left (past part. fem. pl.; las puertas an dexadas 'they have left the gates'; = dejadas)
glossary.pocas: poco — few (fem. pl.; pocas de gentes 'few people'; = pocas)
glossary.fincaran: fincar — they had remained, stayed (-ara form, from the Latin pluperfect, 3rd pl.; most often with pluperfect force, 'had remained', = habían quedado; it can also serve as a plain past, = quedaron)
glossary.derramadas: derramar — scattered, dispersed (past part. fem. pl.; son derramadas 'are scattered'; = derramadas, closest dispersas)
glossary.corríe: correr — he was running, raiding (imperfect 3rd sg., -ié; corríe a Castejón 'he overran Castejón'; = corría)
glossary.avienlos: aver + los — they had them, got them (imperfect 3rd pl. avién + enclitic los; aver de ganançia 'to get as booty'; = los habían)
glossary.gañados: gañado — livestock, herds (pl.; = ganados); also, more broadly, movable goods of every kind (muchos gañados de ovejas e de vacas e de ropas 'much wealth in sheep, cows and clothing')
glossary.andan: andar — they go about, range (present 3rd pl.; = andan)
glossary.rodrigo: Rodrigo — Rodrigo, the Cid's given name (= Rodrigo)
glossary.adeliñava: adeliñar — he was making straight for (imperfect 3rd sg.; = adeliñaba; no modern equivalent, closest dirigirse a)
glossary.vidieron: veer — they saw (strong preterite 3rd pl.; = vieron)
glossary.rebata: rebata — sudden alarm, surprise attack (= rebato)
glossary.desenparada: desenparar — abandoned, left defenceless (past part. fem.; fo desenparada 'was abandoned', passive; = desamparada)
glossary.ruy: Ruy — Ruy, short form of Rodrigo (= Ruy)
glossary.desnuda: desnudo — bare, drawn (fem.; espada desnuda 'drawn sword'; = desnuda)
glossary.matava: matar — he was killing (imperfect 3rd sg.; = mataba)
glossary.alcançava: alcançar — he was overtaking, catching (imperfect 3rd sg.; = alcanzaba)
glossary.gañó: gañar — he won, captured (preterite 3rd sg.; = ganó)
glossary.ela: ela — the (fem. article, an archaic form, Latin illa; y ela plata 'and the silver'; = la)
glossary.déxanla: dexar + la — they leave her/it (present dexan + enclitic la; = la dejan)
glossary.preçia: preçiar — to value, prize (present; preçia' with Pidal's apostrophe = preçian, 3rd pl., its n merged with the n of a following nada: non preçia' nada 'they prize it at nothing'; = precian, aprecian)
glossary.dubda: dubda — doubt; also fear (sin dubda 'without fear', or 'without doubt, surely'; = duda)
glossary.corren: correr — they run, raid (present 3rd pl.; = corren)
glossary.preavan: prear — they were plundering (imperfect 3rd pl.; Latin praedare, cf. prea 'booty'; = preaban; no modern verb, closest saquear)
glossary.seña: seña — banner, standard (= seña; modern seña is 'sign', the banner sense is enseña)
glossary.desí: desí — from there, thence; thereupon (adverb, des + i 'there'; e desí arriba 'and from there upward'; = desde allí, después)
glossary.tórnanse: tornar + se — they turn back, return (present tornan + enclitic se; = se tornan, closest vuelven)
glossary.largas: largo — abundant, generous (fem. pl.; riquizas largas 'abundant riches'; = largas)
glossary.derecha: derecho — straight (fem.; derecha viene 'comes straight on'; = derecha, closest directamente)
glossary.fellos: fe + los — here they are, behold them (the presentative fe, as in afé, afevos, + enclitic los; = helos)
glossary.saliólos: salir + los — he went out to (them) (preterite salió + enclitic los; saliólos reçebir 'went out to welcome them'; = salió a recibirlos)
glossary.mesnada: mesnada — household troop, band of followers (= mesnada)
glossary.reçibe: reçebir — he welcomes, receives (present 3rd sg.; = recibe)
glossary.albarfáñez: Albarfáñez — Álvar Fáñez written as one word (= Álvar Fáñez)
glossary.enbiás: enbiar — I should send (imperfect subjunctive, apocopated -ás for -asse; do yo vos enbiás 'wherever I might send you'; = enviase; the person and tense analysis is uncertain)
glossary.abría: aver — I would have (conditional 1st sg., syncopated; bien abría tal esperança 'I would have such hope'; = habría)
glossary.esso: esso — that (neuter demonstrative; esso con esto 'that together with this'; = eso)
glossary.ajuntado: ajuntar — joined, added (past part.; sea ajuntado 'let it be added'; = juntado, ajuntar is regional)
glossary.quinta: quinta — fifth, the fifth part of the booty, a share due by custom (= quinta; legal quinto, 'a fifth')
glossary.quisiéredes: querer — you shall wish (future subjunctive 2nd pl.; si la quisiéredes 'if you wish it'; = quisiereis, tense obsolete)
glossary.quinto: quinto — fifth, the fifth part of the booty (= quinto; el quinto or la quinta, the share due by custom; d'aqueste quinto 'of this fifth')
glossary.avedes: aver — you have (2nd pl. present, -edes; perfect auxiliary with a participle, me avedes mandado 'you have granted me'; = habéis)
glossary.pagar: pagar — to pay, to satisfy (infinitive; pagar se ya 'he would be satisfied'; por pagar 'still unpaid, yet to be paid'; = pagar, pagarse)
glossary.delle: de + elle — of it, with it (elle, old form of él, Latin ille; pagar se ya delle 'would be satisfied with it'; = de él, de ello)
glossary.castellano: castellano — Castilian, of Castile (el Castellano, epithet of Alfonso as king of Castile; = castellano)
glossary.suelto: soltar — I release, let go (present 1st sg.; = suelto)
glossary.avello: aver + lo — to have it (infinitive aver with enclitic lo, rl > ll; avello quitado 'to hold it as remitted'; = haberlo; the analysis is the usual one but not certain)
glossary.quitado: quitar — remitted, waived, given up (past part., of a debt or claim; avello quitado 'to hold it remitted'; closest condonado, renunciado)
glossary.pague: pagar — (that) I be satisfied, paid (present subjunctive 1st sg., reflexive me pague; fata que yo me pague 'until I am satisfied'; = pague)
glossary.campo: campo — field, open ground, field of battle (= campo; en el campo 'in the open field'; the element in Campeador) · campo de Taranz 'the plain of Taranz'
glossary.enpleye: enplear — (that) I may employ, use (present subjunctive 1st sg.; enpleye la lança 'may I ply the lance'; = emplee)
glossary.meta: meter — (that) I put, lay (present subjunctive 1st sg.; meta mano 'lay hand to (the sword)'; = meta)
glossary.destellando: destellar — dripping, trickling (gerund; la sangre destellando 'the blood dripping'; Latin destillare; closest destilando, since modern destellar means 'to flash')
glossary.lidiador: lidiador — fighter, warrior (agent noun from lidiar; closest luchador, combatiente)
glossary.prendré: prender — I shall take (future 1st sg., syncopated; non prendré 'I shall not take'; = prenderé, closest tomaré)
glossary.ganaredes: ganar — you shall gain, win (2nd pl., -edes; future, = ganaréis, as Pidal's paraphrase has it; the same letters spell the future subjunctive ganáredes, = ganareis, hayáis ganado)
glossary.quesquier: quesquier — whatever, anything (indefinite; quesquier que sea 'whatever it may be'; no direct modern form, closest cualquier cosa, cualquiera que sea)
glossary.afelo: afé + lo — behold it, here it is (presentative afé with enclitic lo; afelo en vuestra mano 'here it is in your hand'; closest helo aquí)
glossary.juntadas: juntar — gathered, collected (past part. fem. pl., agreeing with ganançias; = juntadas)
glossary.comidiós: comedir + se — he reflected, realized (preterite 3rd sg. comidió + enclitic se, spelled -s; comidiós … que 'he thought that'; Pidal: 'se dio cuenta, reparó, pensó'; modern comedirse means 'to restrain oneself', closest pensó, reparó)
glossary.llegarién: llegar — they would arrive, come up (conditional 3rd pl., -ién; = llegarían)
glossary.compañas: compaña — company, band of troops (pl.; = compañas, closest tropas)
glossary.buscarie: buscar — he would seek (conditional 3rd sg., -ie; buscar mal 'seek to harm'; = buscaría)
glossary.mesnadas: mesnada — household troop, band of followers (pl.; = mesnadas)
glossary.quiñoneros: quiñonero — officer who divides the booty into shares (quiñones) (masc. pl.; sos quiñoneros 'his share-masters'; closest repartidores)
glossary.arribança: arribança — good fortune, prosperity (Pidal: 'buena fortuna, estado próspero'; i an arribança 'they fare well there'; no modern form, closest prosperidad, buena fortuna)
glossary.cada: cada — each, every (= cada; a cada uno 'to each one')
glossary.caden: caer — they fall (to), are due (present 3rd pl. with -d- kept; caden çient marcos 'a hundred marks fall to each'; = caen, closest les corresponden)
glossary.presentaja: presentaja — gift, present (dar en presentaja 'to give as a gift'; Pidal: 'presente, regalo') · also an offer, a price proposed (d'aquesta presentaja 'with this offer'; Pidal: 'oferta o proposición de precio'); no modern form, closest presente, oferta
glossary.cativas: cativo — captive woman, female prisoner (fem. pl.; = cautivas)
glossary.quiso: querer — he wished (strong preterite 3rd sg.; non quiso 'he did not want'; = quiso)
glossary.conprada: comprar — bought (past part. fem. sg., passive with serié; serié conprada 'it would be bought'; = comprada)
glossary.oviessen: aver — they would have (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl.; aun de lo que diessen oviessen grand ganançia 'even from what they might give they would have great profit'; = hubiesen, the subject being the buyers; reading of the clause slightly uncertain)
glossary.asmaron: asmar — they estimated, valued (preterite 3rd pl.; Latin aestimare; closest tasaron, estimaron)
glossary.tercer: tercero — third (apocopated before a noun; tercer dia 'third day'; = tercer)
glossary.dados: dar — given, paid (past part. masc. pl.; dados foron 'were paid'; = dados)
glossary.foron: seer — they were (preterite 3rd pl., variant of fueron; = fueron)
glossary.asmó: asmar — he reckoned, judged (preterite 3rd sg.; closest estimó, juzgó)
glossary.avrie: aver — there would be (conditional 3rd sg., syncopated; non i avrie morada 'there would be no staying'; = habría)
glossary.morada: morada — dwelling, stay, lodging (= morada; non i avrie morada 'one could not stay there')
glossary.serie: seer — it would be (conditional 3rd sg.; = sería; same as serié)
glossary.retenedor: retenedor — that can be held, tenable (adjective from retener 'to hold'; serie retenedor 'it could be held'; no modern equivalent, closest defendible; sense inferred from the contrast mas non i avrie agua)
glossary.paz: paz — peace (= paz; moros en paz 'Moors at peace', i.e. those who have submitted)
glossary.escripta: escrivir — written (past part. fem. sg., Latin scripta; escripta es la carta 'the charter is written'; = escrita)
glossary.buscar: buscar — to seek (infinitive; buscar nos verná 'he will come to seek us'; buscar nos ie 'he would seek us', infinitive + clitic + auxiliary, split future/conditional; = buscar)
glossary.ie: aver — would (reduced imperfect of aver, 3rd sg., as conditional ending after an infinitive with clitic; buscar nos ie 'he would seek us' = nos buscaría; = -ía)
glossary.escuelas: escuela — household troops, retinue (pl.; oid, escuelas 'hear, my men'; Pidal: = mesnadas; not modern 'school'; closest mesnadas, tropas)
glossary.dixiero: dezir — I shall say (future subjunctive 1st sg., archaic -iero; lo que yo dixiero 'whatever I say'; = dijere, a tense now obsolete)
glossary.tengades: tener — (that) you hold (present subjunctive 2nd pl., -ades; non lo tengades a mal 'do not take it ill', prohibition; = tengáis)
glossary.podriemos: poder — we could (conditional 1st pl., syncopated -iemos; = podríamos)
glossary.fincar: fincar — to stay, remain (infinitive; = quedarse, closest quedar)
glossary.verná: venir — he will come (future 3rd sg., syncopated; buscar nos verná 'he will come to seek us'; = vendrá)
glossary.hermar: hermar — to leave desolate, lay waste (infinitive, from yermo 'empty, desert'; = yermar, closest dejar yermo, despoblar)
glossary.pris: prender — I took (short strong preterite 1st sg.; lo pris dellos 'I took it from them'; = prendí, closest tomé)
glossary.digan: dezir — (that) they say (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; que de mí non digan mal 'so that they may not speak ill of me'; = digan)
glossary.pagados: pagar — paid, satisfied (past part. masc. pl.; todos sodes pagados 'you are all satisfied'; = pagados)
glossary.cras: cras — tomorrow (adverb, Latin cras; cras a la mañana 'tomorrow morning'; modern uses mañana)
glossary.lidiar: lidiar — to fight (infinitive; = lidiar, closest luchar)
glossary.plaz: plazer — it pleases (present 3rd sg., apocopated; a todos plaz 'it pleases all'; = place, closest agrada)
glossary.prisieron: prender — they took (strong preterite 3rd pl.; del castiello que prisieron 'of the castle they took'; = prendieron, closest tomaron)
glossary.bendiziéndol: bendezir + le — blessing him (gerund + enclitic le, e elided; bendiziéndol están 'they are blessing him'; = bendiciéndole)
glossary.troçen: troçir — they cross, pass through (present 3rd pl.; troçen las Alcarrias 'they cross the Alcarria'; no direct modern form, closest atraviesan, traspasan)
glossary.alcarrias: Alcarria — the Alcarria, upland region of Guadalajara province (pl., las Alcarrias; = la Alcarria; traditional identification)
glossary.cuevas: cueva — cave (pl.; = cuevas; las Cuevas, first element of the place name las Cuevas d'Anquita)
glossary.anquita: Anquita — Anguita, village in Guadalajara province (las Cuevas d'Anquita; traditional identification, the Cuevas de Anguita)
glossary.passaron: passar — they passed, crossed (preterite 3rd pl.; = pasaron)
glossary.aguas: agua — water, stream (pl.; passaron las aguas 'they crossed the waters', i.e. the streams; = aguas)
glossary.taranz: Taranz — campo de Taranz, part of the plateau dividing the waters of the Tajuña and the Jalón, on the border of the provinces of Guadalajara and Soria (Pidal)
glossary.fariza: Fariza — a place on the route into the Jalón region, usually identified with Ariza (Zaragoza province); identification traditional, f- is the poem's spelling
glossary.çetina: Çetina — Cetina, place in Zaragoza province (= Cetina; traditional identification)
glossary.albergar: albergar — to lodge, halt for the night (infinitive; iva albergar 'went to lodge', i.e. lodged; = albergar, closest alojarse, acampar)
glossary.ardiment: ardiment — boldness, daring; a bold design (apocopated -ment; = ardimiento, closest audacia, designio)
glossary.moviós: mover + se — he set out, moved off (preterite 3rd sg. movió + enclitic se, spelled -s; = se movió, closest se puso en marcha)
glossary.alfama: Alfama — a place on the route, usually identified with Alhama (de Aragón, Zaragoza province); identification traditional
glossary.foz: foz — gorge, narrow river valley (Latin faucem; = hoz; la Foz may be a place name or the gorge itself, reading uncertain)
glossary.bovierca: Bovierca — Bubierca, place in Zaragoza province (traditional identification)
glossary.teca: Teca — Ateca, place in Zaragoza province (traditional identification)
glossary.alcoçer: Alcoçer — Alcocer, a Moorish town the Cid camps before; site now unknown (Pidal: on the left of the Jalón, between Ateca and Calatayud)
glossary.corre: correr — it runs, flows (present 3rd sg.; = corre)
glossary.salón: Salón — the river Jalón (the old form of the name; = Jalón)
glossary.puedent: poder — they can (present 3rd pl., the old plural -nt kept in the spelling; agua nol puedent vedar 'they cannot cut off his water'; = pueden)
glossary.vedar: vedar — to forbid, prevent, cut off (infinitive; agua … vedar 'to deny water'; Latin vetare; closest prohibir, impedir)
glossary.cueda: cuedar — he thinks, expects (present 3rd sg., variant of cuidar; cueda ganar 'he expects to take'; closest cuida, piensa)
glossary.puebla: poblar — he fills, peoples, occupies (present 3rd sg.; bien puebla el otero 'he occupies the hill well'; = puebla)
glossary.firme: firme — firm; used adverbially, 'firmly, securely' (= firmemente)
glossary.prende: prender — he takes, takes up (present 3rd sg.; prende las posadas 'takes up quarters'; = prende)
glossary.contra: contra — toward, facing, in the direction of (= hacia; contra la sierra 'facing the sierra')
glossary.cinxo: çeñir — he girded (strong preterite 3rd sg., Latin cinxit; en buen ora cinxo espada 'in a good hour he girded on the sword'; = ciñó)
glossary.fazer: fazer — to make, do, dig (infinitive; mandó fazer 'ordered made'; = hacer)
glossary.arrebata: arrebata — sudden attack, surprise assault (noun from arrebatar; dar arrebata 'to make a sudden attack'; probably = arrebato/arrebatada)
glossary.sopiessen: saber — (so that) they might know (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl.; = supiesen/supieran)
glossary.fincança: fincança — staying, sojourn, settled stay (noun from fincar 'to stay'; avie fincança 'had settled in'; = permanencia, estancia)
glossary.mandados: mandado — message, news, report (pl.; here the tidings that spread; = mandados)
glossary.venido: venir — come (past part.; venido es 'has come', ser as perfect auxiliary; = venido)
glossary.alegrando: alegrar — rejoicing, cheering (gerund; alegrando se va 'goes along rejoicing'; = alegrándose)
glossary.paria: paria — tribute paid by a Muslim town for protection (sg.; en paria 'as tribute'; see parias)
glossary.yal: ya + le — now ... to him (ya 'now' + elided le; yal dan parias 'now they pay him tribute')
glossary.terrer: Terrer — place name, a town near Calatayud (probably modern Terrer, Zaragoza province)
glossary.calatauth: Calatauth — place name, Calatayud (Zaragoza province; from Arabic Qal'at Ayyūb)
glossary.sabet: saber — know, mark you (imperative 2nd pl., sabed; sabet = sabed; epic tag addressed to the audience)
glossary.ma: mal — ill, sorely (adverb, with the l lost before les: ma'les = mal les, Pidal; ma'les pesava 'it grieved them sorely'; = mal)
glossary.pesava: pesar — it grieved, it weighed on (imperfect 3rd sg.; les pesava 'it grieved them'; = pesaba)
glossary.yogo: yazer — he lay, stayed encamped (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = yació)
glossary.complidas: complido — complete, full (fem. pl.; complidas quinze sedmanas 'a full fifteen weeks'; = cumplidas)
glossary.elle: elle — he (old form of él, Latin ille; elle fizo = él hizo; Pidal restores el[le])
glossary.art: art — trick, stratagem of war (masc. here, un art; Latin ars; Pidal 'ardid de guerra'; = arte, ardid)
glossary.levava: levar — he was carrying off, taking away (imperfect 3rd sg.; = llevaba)
glossary.alçada: alçar — raised (past part. fem.; la su seña alçada 'with his banner raised'; = alzada)
glossary.lorigas: loriga — coat of mail, hauberk (pl.; = lorigas)
glossary.vestidas: vestir — put on, clad in (past part. fem. pl.; = vestidas)
glossary.çintas: çinto — girded, belted on (old strong past part. of çeñir, Latin cinctus, used as adjective, fem. pl.; çintas las espadas 'with swords girded on'; = ceñidas)
glossary.sacarlos: sacar + los — to draw them out (infinitive with enclitic object; sacar a çelada 'to lure into ambush'; = sacarlos)
glossary.vidienlo: veer + lo — they saw him (imperfect 3rd pl. vidien, an old form, with enclitic lo; = lo veían)
glossary.alabavan: alabar — they were boasting, praising themselves (imperfect 3rd pl., reflexive alabarse; = alababan)
glossary.fallido: fallir — failed, lacking, run out (past part.; fallido ha a mio Çid el pan 'the Cid has run out of bread'; = faltado)
glossary.abés: abés — hardly, scarcely (Latin ad vix; = apenas)
glossary.lieva: levar — he carries off (present 3rd sg.; = lleva)
glossary.dexada: dexar — left (past part.; una tienda a dexada 'he has left one tent'; = dejada)
glossary.escapasse: escapar — (as if) he were escaping (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg.; commo si escapasse 'as if he were fleeing'; = escapase)
glossary.arrancada: arrancada — rout, headlong flight; also the pursuit and rout of the enemy (de arrancada 'in rout'; el arrancada, el before a vowel-initial fem. noun; = arrancada)
glossary.demos: dar — let us give (present subjunctive 1st pl.; demos salto 'let us make a dash'; = demos)
glossary.prenden: prender — they take, seize (present 3rd pl.; = prenden)
glossary.darán: dar — they will give (future 3rd pl.; = darán)
glossary.dent: dent — of it, thereof (de + ent, a form of ende 'thence'; non nos darán dent nada 'they will give us none of it'; = de ello)
glossary.qu: que — that, which (que elided before a vowel; qu'él a presa 'that he has taken')
glossary.presa: prender — taken (past part. fem.; la paria que a presa 'the tribute he has taken'; = prendida, tomada)
glossary.much: mucho — much, very (apocopated form; much estraña 'very strange/great')
glossary.estraña: estraño — extraordinary, remarkable, great (fem.; priessa much estraña 'a most extraordinary rush'; = extraña)
glossary.cogiós: coger + se — he withdrew, took himself off (preterite 3rd sg. with enclitic se, cogióse; cogiós commo de arrancada 'he withdrew as if in rout'; = se recogió)
glossary.cojós: coger + se — he went off, took himself (preterite 3rd sg. with enclitic se, cojóse; cojós Salón ayuso 'he set off down the Jalón'; = se fue)
glossary.anda: andar — he goes, goes along (present 3rd sg.; = anda)
glossary.chicos: chico — small, little (masc. pl.; los grandes e los chicos 'great and small'; = chicos)
glossary.guarda: guardar — he guards, watches (present 3rd sg.; = guarda)
glossary.entrellos: entre + ellos — between them (entrellos y el castiello 'between them and the castle'; = entre ellos)
glossary.plaça: plaça — open space, stretch of open ground (here distance; = plaza)
glossary.espoloneavan: espolonear — they were spurring (imperfect 3rd pl.; = espoloneaban)
glossary.firidlos: ferir + los — strike them! (imperative 2nd pl. with enclitic los; = heridlos)
glossary.sines: sines — without (= sin, with added -es; sines dubdança 'without hesitation')
glossary.ganancia: ganancia — gain, booty (spelling variant of ganançia; = ganancia)
glossary.bueltos: buelto — mingled, mixed in (past part. of bolver; bueltos son con ellos 'they are mixed in with them'; = vueltos, envueltos)
glossary.llaña: llaña — flat ground, plain (= llana, llanura)
glossary.bueno: bueno — good, fine, great (qué bueno es el gozo 'how great is the joy'; = bueno)
glossary.aguijavan: aguijar — they were spurring on, hastening (imperfect 3rd pl.; = aguijaban)
glossary.essora: essora — then, at that moment (ess' + ora; en essora 'at that moment'; = entonces)
glossary.entravan: entrar — they were entering (imperfect 3rd pl.; = entraban)
glossary.piedad: piedad — pity, mercy; sin piedad 'without mercy'
glossary.dexando: dexar — leaving, letting go by (gerund; dexando van los delant 'they go on leaving them (to pass) ahead'; = dejando)
glossary.delant: delant — ahead, in front (apocopated adverb; = delante)
glossary.poral: pora + el — toward the (pora 'toward, for' + article; Pidal restores the a: por[a]l castiello 'toward the castle'; = para el, hacia el)
glossary.tornavan: tornar — they turned back, returned (imperfect 3rd pl.; = tornaban)
glossary.desnudas: desnudo — bare, drawn (fem. pl., of swords; = desnudas)
glossary.paravan: parar(se) — they took their stand, halted (imperfect 3rd pl., reflexive; = paraban)
glossary.llegavan: llegar — they were arriving, came up (imperfect 3rd pl.; = llegaban)
glossary.per: Per — Pero, short for Pedro (Per Vermudoz = Pedro Bermúdez, a vassal of the Cid)
glossary.metióla: meter + la — he put it (preterite 3rd sg. with enclitic la; metióla en somo 'planted it on top'; = la metió)
glossary.fue: seer — he was (preterite 3rd sg.; en buen ora fue nado 'was born in a good hour'; = fue)
glossary.mejoraremos: mejorar — we shall improve (future 1st pl.; mejoraremos posadas 'we shall better our lodgings'; = mejoraremos)
glossary.dueños: dueño — master, owner, lord (pl.; a dueños e a cavallos 'for masters and horses'; = dueños)
glossary.cauallos: cavallo — horse (pl., spelling with u; = caballos)
glossary.preso: prender — taken (past part.; grand aver avemos preso 'we have taken great wealth'; = preso, prendido)
glossary.podremos: poder — we shall be able (future 1st pl.; = podremos)
glossary.descabeçemos: descabeçar — (that) we behead (present subjunctive 1st pl.; que los descabeçemos 'if we behead them'; = descabecemos)
glossary.ganaremos: ganar — we shall gain (future 1st pl.; = ganaremos)
glossary.cojámoslos: coger + los — let us take, gather them (present subjunctive 1st pl. with enclitic los; cojámoslos de dentro 'let us take them from inside', exact sense uncertain; = cojámoslos)
glossary.tenemos: tener — we have, hold (present 1st pl.; = tenemos)
glossary.posaremos: posar — we shall lodge, stay (future 1st pl.; = posaremos)
glossary.serviremos: servir — we shall make use of, be served by (future 1st pl., nos serviremos reflexive; = serviremos)
